personal.name: Nabeeha Navaal Ahmed
personal.tagline: Social scientist and strategist driving measurable impact through data-driven outreach, product development, and community engagement across 7 countries.
personal.bio: I'm a Minerva University graduate with a background in economics and operations, currently pursuing dual masters at Hult International Business School. I've worked across public outreach, product management, and social impact — from increasing flood awareness for 150,000 people to growing university applications by 400%. I bring a global perspective shaped by living and working in Seoul, Berlin, Buenos Aires, Taipei, London, and San Francisco.

experience.title: Product Manager - Nutrilinq
bullets: Identified a nutritional support gap in the GLP-1 consumer market through market and literature review of a ~$2.5B category and pitched and developed a supplement concept.
Designed and executed go-to-market and commercialization activities by evaluating retail channels, onboarding 45 partners, developing the product website, and supporting sales efforts.

experience.title: Product Manager Intern
bullets: Coordinated development of a college-guidance application by managing a cross-functional team of 11 interns and volunteers working on financial data research, AI-assisted content generation, and UX/UI design.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant - Global Development and Applied Economics
bullets: Graded assignments and in-class responses for 25 students per semester under fixed weekly deadlines.
Reviewed student work to identify recurring technical (R, Python) and theoretical gaps and coached students to resolve misconceptions.

experience.title: Founding Director of Programs
bullets: Designed and executed a structured programming plan by launching 7 live Zoom podcasts featuring Pakistani policymakers and leaders, achieving an average of 3,835 views per episode and ~12.5% monthly subscriber growth.
Moderated and coordinated panel discussions, increasing live audience engagement by ~25% over an 8-month period.

experience.title: Media and Public Outreach Intern
experience.org: Valley Water - US Government Department for Water (Bay Area)
bullets: Devised a plan to increase brand awareness, wrote blog posts, managed social media handles, created media content; tracked engagement metrics and prepared periodic updates for internal review. Social Media reach increased by 101,500 views, and blog reach by 1,616 individuals.

Analyzed and recommended improvements for the Flood Awareness Campaign based on previous year's data impacting 150,000 individuals. Using GIS, identified high-risk communities and strategized effective outreach, evacuation, and rehabilitation plans.

Reviewed outreach and distribution data and identified reliance on English-only flood safety pamphlets. Analyzed neighborhood-level demographic and language data to recommend multilingual materials, specifying target neighborhoods and distribution points.

experience.title: Fellow, Outstanding Contribution Award
bullets: Analyzed public health data to identify gaps in First Aid Awareness Programs within underprivileged communities, leading to an Urdu-language intervention.
Collaborated with 4 doctors to develop a standardized First Aid syllabus in Urdu covering all age groups and core emergency scenarios.
Organized and delivered 5 First Aid awareness sessions, educating 67 students across targeted communities.

experience.title: Outreach Intern
bullets: Supported institutional outreach across the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan, delivering presentations in 16 countries; efforts culminated in an average increase of ~12,500 applications per year.
Coordinated engagements with educational institutions and USEFP bodies in Pakistan, rendering a 22% growth in Minerva's reach within Pakistan.
Reviewed application data to identify Karachi as an underrepresented city; supported targeted outreach contributing to a 400% increase in applications from the region.

experience.title: Environmental Business Consultant
bullets: Analyzed the B-Corp certification framework and evaluation criteria to identify priority operational and governance gaps.
Audited business practices against B-Corp standards and developed recommendations that supported a ~60% increase in the company's B-Corp score.

experience.title: Research Intern & Project Manager
bullets: Conducted mixed-methods research on homelessness in San Francisco to identify gaps in information synthesis and accessibility affecting service delivery.
Managed a research team of 4 contributors to deliver a consolidated pitch deck with evidence-based recommendations for policy discussion.
